'''Marstro''' was a captain of a mercenary fighter squadron. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the squadron sustained damage and Marstro suspected sabotage.<ref >{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Bomb Squadron}}</ref>
